Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379),

Thinking it over I had rather, since you are so kind, keep [the £200](/topic/160) on credit, as I think the receipt for /this\ next year, considering the [Cameos](/book/124) and the two French histories must a good deal more than cover that sum, and it is convenient to me to have it in hand just now[^1]

Yours truly

C M Yonge


[^1]: The \'two French histories\' were the [History of France](/book/99), in the \'Historical Course for Schools\' which E. A.

Freeman, the series editor, was making her rewrite, and which was not actually published until 1879; and the [History of France](/book/353) (1878) which she was contributing to the \'History Primers\' series edited by J. R.

Green.

The former was aimed at older children, and had ten chapters rather than eight.
